name: Speechify
summary: Text-to-speech for documents, PDFs and web pages.
description: Speechify turns documents, PDFs, emails and web pages into audio with natural voices at adjustable speed. It also offers voiceover, dubbing and voice cloning on mobile, browser and desktop.

pricing.label: Freemium
pricing.note: Price label carried over from the previous catalog and not rechecked.

features: Reads documents, PDFs and web pages aloud

howToUse.title: Download or Access Speechify
howToUse.description: Use the web app or download Speechify for your device.

howToUse.title: Import or Paste Text
howToUse.description: Add the content you want to convert to audio (documents, web pages, etc.).

howToUse.title: Select Voice and Language
howToUse.description: Choose from hundreds of voices and 60+ languages.

howToUse.title: Listen, Download, or Share
howToUse.description: Listen to generated audio or export/share it as needed.

features_fr: Lecture à voix haute de documents, PDF et pages web
summary_fr: Lecture à voix haute de textes, PDF et pages web.
description_fr: Speechify convertit documents, PDF, emails et pages web en audio avec des voix naturelles, à vitesse réglable. Il propose aussi la voix off, le doublage et le clonage de voix, sur mobile, navigateur et ordinateur.
